states.ANSWER: Fresh authoritative evidence supports the scoped answer.
states.QUALIFY: Evidence exists but the capability is planned, gated, library-only, volatile or otherwise scope-limited.
states.CONFLICT: Authoritative sources disagree or dependent copy conflicts with stronger evidence. State the boundary and do not choose the stronger answer.
states.UNKNOWN: No approved current source establishes the fact.
states.REFUSE_AUTHORITY: The requested statement would imply professional, safety, compliance, permission or AI authority Arq does not have.

decisionOrder: resolve canonical object and user context
neverInfer: end-to-end import/export from parser/adapter tests alone
portable-file publication from a journal write
compatibility from a file extension alone
a project is open from compatibility preflight
permission from a visible control alone
hardware support from browser availability alone
privacy transport from product aspiration alone
